subject: Unexpected accelerated ingest flag & quarter-close billing impact
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <procurement@opencartel.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: Maya Singh <cfo@opencartel.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden jump in May consumption — possible double-counting?

Hi Tessa,

We reviewed our May invoice (attached) and noticed a 3.1x increase in ingest tokens compared to April. The line items show an "accelerated_ingest" flag for many batches we didn't explicitly schedule. Can you confirm whether this is expected?

Given we're closing the quarter, Maya has asked we put a hold on payment for the May invoice until we understand the root cause — specifically whether duplicate replay requests were counted twice during our migration window.

Attached: OpenCartel_May_invoice.pdf; sample_usage_excerpt.csv (first 500 rows)

Can you confirm receipt and estimated time to investigate?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Lead
OpenCartel Inc
procurement@opencartel.com

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.example.com
To: Liam O'Connor <procurement@opencartel.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <cfo@opencartel.com>, ben.carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden jump in May consumption — possible double-counting?

Hi Liam / Maya,

Received — thanks for the heads up and for including the sample excerpt and invoice. I'm opening an investigation now and we've temporarily flagged the invoice for review on our side to avoid automated collection while we dig in.

Initial next steps:
- I'll loop in Ben (infra) to pull token-level traces for the date ranges you highlighted.
- Please confirm the exact timezone and migration windows you ran bulk replays in May (start/end times in UTC). That will help us correlate retries.
- I'll request a provisional pro-forma hold so our billing team doesn't route the invoice for external collection until we have a root-cause estimate.

Can you also share the migration run-id if you have it? That speeds correlation.

I'll get back with an initial tech read within 24 hours and a remediation proposal within 3 business days.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Manager, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: ben.carter@redwood.example.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.example.com, Liam O'Connor <procurement@opencartel.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden jump in May consumption — possible double-counting?

Tessa / Liam,

Quick technical summary from the first-pass log pull (attached token_replay_trace.json and a link to our internal correlation view):

- We see a concentrated spike between 2027-05-18T22:30:00Z and 2027-05-18T23:12:00Z from IPs associated with OpenCartel's migration bucket.
- Multiple ingest batches show identical client-side request-ids but different server request-ids, which indicates the client retried the same payload against multiple gateway endpoints. Each retry appears to have been accepted and counted by the ingest metering pipeline.
- There's a subtle race in our replay de-duplication step when the same payload hits ephemeral gateway replicas within a 120s window; de-duplication currently relies on a per-gateway cache that didn't synchronize fast enough under your parallel migration.

Impact estimate: ~42% of the spike token volume looks like near-duplicate replays that were billed. The rest were legitimate increased throughput.

Actionable remediation options:
1) Retroactive credit for the duplicate portion (~42% of the spike window) and a corrected invoice line.
2) Issue a one-time goodwill credit while we push a patch to centralize replay de-duplication (low-latency cache coordination).
3) If you prefer, we can provide a token-level export for your audit team and leave the invoice unchanged pending your sign-off.

I'll coordinate a reproduction test with our infra team to validate the fix. Laura from billing is CC'd to help with the pro-forma adjustment if we agree on credits.

Attachments: token_replay_trace.json (excerpt)

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <cfo@opencartel.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.example.com, ben.carter@redwood.example.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <procurement@opencartel.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 07:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden jump in May consumption — possible double-counting?

Tessa / Ben,

Thank you for the prompt investigation and the initial analysis — that aligns with the migration window we ran. For context: we began a multi-node replay from 2027-05-18T22:27:00Z to 2027-05-18T23:15:00Z (UTC). Run-id: oc-replay-20270518-3. We did see increased retries as our orchestration retried on transient failures — happy to share run logs separately.

We are willing to accept a retroactive credit for the duplicate portion, but we need two things before we can close our books for Q2:
1) A pro-forma adjusted invoice showing the credit and the net amount due (we will hold payment until we confirm the adjusted invoice).
2) Confirmation of VAT implications — if you issue a credit note rather than a replacement invoice, we need to understand how that will affect our EU VAT reclaim for the quarter. Our tax team is located in Ireland (VAT ID: IE1234567F).

Timeline: can you provide the adjusted invoice and VAT note by close of business Wednesday (2027-06-16)? We need this to finalize the quarter.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Chief Financial Officer
OpenCartel Inc
cfo@opencartel.com

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.example.com
To: Maya Singh <cfo@opencartel.com>, Liam O'Connor <procurement@opencartel.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.example.com, laura.bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden jump in May consumption — possible double-counting?

Maya / Liam —

Thanks for confirming the replay window and run-id. Summary and agreed next steps: 

Summary of findings:
- Root cause: client-side parallel replay + per-gateway de-dup race resulting in ~42% duplicate token billing for the 2027-05-18 22:30-23:12 UTC window.
- Remediation: infra patch to centralize replay de-duplication (in progress; target deploy 2027-06-22).

Agreed billing actions:
1) We'll issue a pro-forma adjusted invoice that reduces the billed token volume for the affected window by 42% and applies a corresponding credit. The adjusted amount will be provided as a credit note with a replacement invoice option — Laura (billing) will produce both documents.
2) Our tax/compliance team will append a VAT position note explaining credit vs. replacement invoice implications for EU customers; we will include the reference VAT ID you provided.
3) We will hold external collection for invoice OPC-4721 until you confirm acceptance of the pro-forma adjusted invoice or until 2027-06-30 (whichever is sooner).

Deliverables & timeline:
- 2027-06-16 COB: Laura will send the pro-forma adjusted invoice and VAT note (DocuSign link below for paper trail).
- 2027-06-22: Deployment of de-duplication fix to prevent recurrence.
- Post-deploy: we will run a replay test and share token-level export for your auditors.

DocuSign hold link: https://docusign.example.com/invoice-hold/OPC-4721
Internal log extract: https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/ops/logs/opencartel/spike-20270612

If this plan works, please reply with explicit approval to proceed and we'll move forward on the pro-forma and VAT note.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Manager, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123
